text: An agreement between the creditor and debtor for the sum of $15,000 in total is reached. The debtor will repay the loan over thirty monthly payments including the agreed interest rate. The payments should be made on the fifth day of each month until the entire amount is paid off.
label: Contract

text: The landlord agrees to grant access to the residential property for the period of time set out in the lease agreement. The tenant agrees to maintain the property in good condition and to pay all bills related to utilities. Each party needs to give thirty days notice in writing before ending the agreement.
label: Contract

text: The two firms will enter into a partnership in order to render digital marketing services. Each firm will contribute to the partnership and divide the profit as per the agreed percentages in this agreement. Modifications to this agreement need the written consent of both parties.
label: Contract

text: The contractor agrees to complete the renovation of the property within sixty days. The total amount of the contract is $8,000 and should be paid in three installments as per the progress of the project. The contractor has to use approved materials in his work.
label: Contract

text: The customer undertakes to subscribe to a cloud storage solution offered by the company for a period of twelve months. The cost of this subscription is $120 per year paid in advance. The company undertakes to offer access to the cloud platform and operate it based on the availability requirements stated in this contract.
label: Contract

text: This confidentiality agreement obligates both parties to keep secret all business information that was exchanged between them in the course of their cooperation. Neither party can divulge any such information to third parties without prior written consent. This agreement shall be valid for three years from its termination.
label: Contract

text: Agreement is concluded between Green Valley Properties and the tenant for renting an apartment No 12. The tenant is to pay a monthly rental of $850 on the first day of each month. The contract is to remain valid for one year, from January 1, 2026.
label: Contract

text: The service provider shall provide software development services to the client as required in this agreement. The total cost to be paid by the client upon completion of the project is $4,500. Additional work can be done only if it is agreed by the two parties in writing.
label: Contract

text: Agreement for purchasing office equipment between both parties. The seller shall supply the items listed here within fifteen business days after getting the payment. The transfer of ownership of the equipment will happen once the full payment is made.
label: Contract

text: The employee agrees to work for the company as a marketing specialist in full time. The date from which the relationship will be started is March 1, 2026, with the salary of $1,200 per month. The employee must abide by company’s internal policy and keep confidential all business information.
label: Contract

text: I have found an entry on my credit report stating an account that I have not opened. I contacted the credit reporting company and told them that this account is not mine. They promised to check the problem, but the incorrect information still appears on my report and prevents me from getting new credit.
label: Complaint

text: I have paid the bank earlier than the due date but received a late payment fee anyway. I contacted the customer support and showed them the payment proof but they cannot explain me why the payment wasn't registered on time and don't want to remove the additional charge.
label: Complaint

text: The debt collection agency is calling me regarding some debt that I do not know anything about. I asked for the written proof from them and where the debt comes from, but I haven't got it yet. In spite of numerous calls from my side they continue calling me and asking for payment.
label: Complaint

text: The bank put my checking account on hold and didn't give me any explanation. I went to the local branch several times and called the customer service repeatedly, but nobody could tell me when I would be able to withdraw money from my account. This problem makes life hard for me.
label: Complaint

text: I recently cleared my personal loan, but the creditor keeps reporting my outstanding balance with the credit bureau. I called the company requesting an update of my account information. Several weeks have passed, and my balance is incorrect. It may be affecting my credit rating and ability to apply for a loan.
label: Complaint

text: I used my bank's online service to make a payment, and it showed up as successful. But the payment was not made to the recipient. I contacted the bank requesting them to look into it and return the money in case of failure of the transaction.
label: Complaint

text: My mortgage servicer changed my monthly mortgage amount without giving any reason for it. I looked at my previous statements and saw some extra charges, which I could not comprehend. I contacted customer support requesting an explanation and clarification, but I have not received it.
label: Complaint

text: There were several unauthorized transactions in my credit card statement. As soon as I spotted those, I called the issuer of the card requesting to investigate the issue. Despite confirming my request, the company keeps the unauthorized transactions on my statement without solving my dispute.
label: Complaint

text: I filed a request for a student loan repayment adjustment due to changes in my finances. I provided all required documents in time; however, the servicing company went on billing me at the previous amount each month. I tried contacting them repeatedly, but my request still hasn't been processed, and I fear making late payments.
label: Complaint

text: The bank charged me overdraft fees even though I had already made a deposit sufficient enough to cover my spending. I tried contacting the bank and asked them for an explanation of how those fees were counted. However, the customer service representative declined to review the transactions, and no refund was issued.
label: Complaint

text: I have forgotten my company portal password. Despite attempting to reissue a password reset link, I am not receiving any email (neither in my inbox or spam), so I need my account to be reactivated at the very latest today as I am unable to access work files.
label: Service Request

text: Furthermore, the VPN application frequently disconnects whilst I am working from home. This results in a 'session timed-out' message and I then lose access to our internal file server. I have already re-set my router and reinstalled the application, but the issue is continuing. Please investigate my account and the relevant VPN settings.
label: Service Request

text: Whilst I am unable to see our 3rd floor printer on my laptop, members of staff are able to. I have de-registered and re-registered the printer but this has not resolved the issue. Would you please review the printer driver and/or network settings so that I can print off materials for a meeting tomorrow?
label: Service Request

text: To undertake some data analysis I require Python and Visual Studio Code to be installed on my work laptop. However, I lack admin rights and so am unable to do this. Could you authorise and then install these programmes, or alternatively, grant me limited admin rights to allow me to install them?
label: Service Request

text: My laptop has significantly slowed down in recent weeks. Not only does it take around 10 minutes to boot up, but also I experience programme crashes when opening more than 2 windows. Although I have already cleared my laptop of unnecessary files and re-started it numerous times, I suspect that my hard drive and/or memory may require investigation.
label: Service Request

text: I have been unable to dispatch emails from my Outlook account since this morning. Emails remain within my outbox and an alert indicates that my mailbox is full despite me having deleted a large number of previous emails. I am however able to receive emails. Please either enlarge my mailbox space or advise me on why this issue is occurring.
label: Service Request

text: The Wi-Fi in meeting room B is highly unreliable. During online video conferences the connection frequently fails and at times even disappears from the selection of available networks. Other rooms appear to be experiencing no issues. Kindly investigate the access point in room B ahead of our client presentation on Thursday.
label: Service Request

text: Although I transferred across to the finance team recently, I am still unable to access our team budget folder. I am continually informed that I lack the appropriate permissions for this. My manager has already emailed to confirm that she has authorised me to access this folder. Please ensure my account is allocated to the right group so that I can begin report analysis.
label: Service Request

text: A new team member commences work on Monday and will be based in support. Please set up their work station including a laptop, second screen, company email account and access to our internal chat function. All of these should be in place by 9 o'clock on their first day of work.
label: Service Request

text: I have recently received a new mobile telephone. However, my authentication application is no longer able to provide me with security codes for my work account and so I am barred from accessing all systems. Unfortunately my previous phone has also become unusable as it was misplaced. Please re-initialise my multi-factor authentication so that I can enrol my new phone.
label: Service Request
